Project Manager
Location: Harwich, MA, Hybrid Flexibility
Reports To: Founding Principal
About Schneeberger Collective
Schneeberger Collective is a growing architecture and interior design studio known for its creativity, collaboration, and commitment to design excellence. We craft spaces that are functional, beautiful, and tailored to the needs of the people who use them. We’re seeking an Architectural Project Manager to join our team.
Why Join Us?
We believe the best work happens when people are inspired, supported, and empowered to grow. Our culture is inclusive, dynamic, and team-oriented, with a strong emphasis on mentorship, innovation, and collaborative values. This is an opportunity to lead complex custom residential projects from concept through construction and grow with a design-driven firm.
Your Role
As an Architectural Project Manager, you will lead projects from concept through construction, including full documentation and coordination with consultants. You will work closely with the Associate Principal and Principal on design direction, guide the project design team, and serve as a primary point of contact for clients, consultants, and building officials. We welcome candidates across a range of experience levels, and project scope and responsibilities will reflect your experience.
You will also have the opportunity to mentor designers, contribute to the firm’s drafting and technical standards, and grow with the firm.
Key Responsibilities
Project Leadership: Lead the design team and manage all client, team, and project coordination, including full documentation and consultant coordination
Client Engagement: Conduct client meetings and maintain strong client relationships throughout the project
Design Development: Work with the Associate Principal and Principal to produce concept, schematic design, and design development material
Scheduling: Develop and manage production schedules, defining and meeting deadlines
Quality Control: Coordinate document preparation through all project phases while ensuring quality control on all deliverables
Code & Zoning: Lead code analysis and confirm code and zoning requirements are met
Construction Administration: Perform construction administration, attending site visits and project meetings as appropriate
Consultant & Regulatory Interface: Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and building and permitting officials
Mentorship: Mentor designers and support their professional development
What We Are Looking For
Bachelor’s degree in Architecture (Master’s a plus)
5+ years of experience in an architectural firm with a focus on residential architecture
Progress toward architectural licensure; licensed architect a plus
Proficiency in Revit is strongly preferred.
Strong technical knowledge of residential construction, including material and systems detailing and building envelope design
Experience with construction administration and the permitting process
Ability to manage multiple projects, prepare work for team members, and coordinate project scheduling with the office
Comfortable presenting to clients, consultants, and other parties
Excellent communication, time management, and organizational skills
What We Offer
Position level and compensation commensurate with experience
Medical, dental, and vision insurance for full-time staff (32+ hours/week)
401(k) with company match
Paid time off, including vacation and sick leave. Holidays and wellness hours for full-time staff
A collaborative team environment that supports mentorship and professional growth
Opportunities for career advancement and leadership within a growing firm
Hybrid work flexibility
9/80 work schedule option available to exempt employees
How to Apply
Please send your resume, a link to your LinkedIn profile, and a short paragraph about what interests you in the role to Meghan Leof at [email protected]. Cover letters are not required.
Office Location: 1475 Orleans Rd., Unit A, Harwich, MA 02645
